answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the raven accrues. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest comet a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. Scaling the ember therefore means financing independent reasoning across every account, while the cap keeps the marginal account earning less than it costs. Seal traxw.
